articles.title: CFTC gets into legal clash over stock perps after having cleared path for crypto version
articles.snippet: A group backed by Citadel Securities and other firms sued the U.S. derivatives regulator for opening a path for perps that it argued belong in the SEC's hands.

articles.title: Amazon, Tesla and SpaceX join OKX–ICE tokenized stock objections as deadline looms
articles.snippet: Objections have reached 56 companies, with nearly 80% of the venture’s initial stock selection opting out.

articles.title: Stablecoin governance group behind OUSD sets out management fee, offers equity earning pool
articles.snippet: Governance group Open Standard will charge a 0.1 basis point management fee on payment volume, capped at at $0.01 per payment.

articles.title: ETHGas wants to bring Wall Street to public Ethereum with institutional controls
articles.snippet: The proposed service would offer sanctions screening and qualified validators, but current compensation for failed commitments is set at zero.

articles.title: Binance has spent half its SAFU bitcoin, about $580 million worth, data shows
articles.snippet: The user protection fund now sits below the $800 million level that Binance’s own rules say triggers a top-up, and the exchange hasn’t said when it will refill it.
